issue_title: Performance regression on project detail pages: /projects/note-structurer (77) and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue (73)
issue_body:
## Performance Regression — Project Detail Pages

Two project detail pages have dropped materially below the 85 performance threshold and are trending worse across consecutive audits.

### Affected pages

| Page | Prev perf | Curr perf | Δ | LCP | TBT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 83 | **77** | −6 | 4448 ms | 208 ms |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 80 | **73** | −7 | 4936 ms | 238 ms |

### Trend
Both pages have shown consistent deterioration over at least two audit cycles. LCP on the screenshot-to-primevue page has crossed 4.9 s; TBT has grown to 208–238 ms on mobile.

### Recommended fixes
1. **Convert LCP images to WebP/AVIF** and add explicit `width`/`height` to eliminate layout shift pressure.
2. **Defer or code-split non-critical scripts** — high TBT suggests main-thread blocking on page load.
3. **Preload the LCP image** with `<link rel="preload" as="image">` to shorten the critical path.
4. Consider lazy-loading below-fold demo assets (canvas, waveform workers) that may be initialising eagerly.

### Severity
Both pages are public portfolio pieces linked from the projects index. Performance scores in the low 70s on mobile are likely hurting first impressions and Core Web Vitals rankings.
